ObjectName.value: British Airways Flight 217 Boarding Pass

Categories.value: Self-published work|Boarding passes of British Airways

ImageDescription.value:
A boarding pass for a British Airways flight between Heathrow Airport and Washington Dulles International Airport. This was my boarding pass for my first ever trip to the USA, and it features the initials DSAB (disabled) and the designator 'AUTISTIC', as my parents wanted me to have a bit of extra assistance navigating Heathrow. I initially thought I wouldn't need it, as I'm on the higher functioning side of the spectrum, but it turned out that the terminal was much busier than I thought it would be - BA's staff were an absolute delight in helping me make my way through the crowds to my gate.
This scan features some faded text, which wasn't due to the printing of the boarding pass, but rather portions of the ink rubbed off when I had it folded in my passport while I was walking around Heathrow. The portions that have been censored are an identifying number relating to British Airways Executive Club, which I don't want to be freely available, for obvious reasons.

Credit.value: Own work
